title: 第23章 迎娶之事摆聚灵阵第24章 叶蚯杀手赌怪上身
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
只隔了一日。
陈景安就再度溜进了县令府，摸到胡杏儿的屋子里。
胡杏儿本来还因为朱小姐说的话惴惴不安。
如今见了情郎，仿佛终于有了主心骨。
陈景安听过胡杏儿的话，顿时面露喜色。
这就怀上了？
还真是意外之喜，那自己也得准备把胡杏儿给娶进门了。
这点基本的礼数陈景安还是有的。
而且，这事情已经在祖父那里报备过了，也不怕中途再生波折。
不过。
当他得知朱小姐也知道这事的时候，眼神顿时变得危险了起来，生出了灭口的打算。
胡杏儿被他这凶狠的模样吓住，立刻为朱小姐说起好话。
“钰儿她应该早就知道我们的事情了，可是一直都没有揭穿。
若是真的要害我，也不会等到今天。”
听到这话，陈景安的杀意稍稍褪去。
胡杏儿说的是有道理不假。
但问题是——
她骂自己也就算了，因为陈景安不会在这种问题上与女人计较。
可那朱小姐竟然还想怂恿胡杏儿把他的孩子给打掉，然后再嫁给别人。
这已经是没把自己当人看了。

他的眼神里闪过一丝危险的气息，但又不想影响到胡杏儿的心情，于是搂着人坐在床上。
借着胡杏儿的香味与体温，逐步让自己的心情平复下来。
大概是这阵子老爷子与二伯着重锻炼他的缘故。
在一些事情上，陈景安已经会做出与老爷子相似的决定。
可他与老爷子还差了一点。
至少，自己刚才只是想着要杀人灭口。
可如果换成老爷子。
他会始终谨记朱小姐这县令之女的身份，至少不会在清河县内与之为难。
等他们出去之后，才会找机会下手。
不过转念一想。
若是站在胡杏儿的角度，朱小姐的话就可以称得上是真心实意了。
但胡杏儿最终还是选择了他。
这也让陈景安的身心同时得到了满足。
他一直待到胡杏儿睡去，这才又不动声色的离开。
……
次日一早。
陈景安看过孩子之后，立刻就找他爹商量迎娶的事情。
陈父表示一切都包在他身上，并且督促陈景安快点去修炼，莫要让老爷子失望了。
content_en:
It was only one day apart.
Chen Jingan sneaked into the county magistrate's office again and touched Myolie Wu's house.
Myolie Wu was originally worried because of what Miss Zhu said.
Now that I have met my lover, it seems that I finally have a backbone.
After hearing Myolie Wu's words, Chen Jing'an suddenly beamed with joy.
Are you pregnant now?
It was such an unexpected surprise, so I had to prepare to marry Myolie.
Chen Jingan still has this basic etiquette.
Moreover, this matter has been reported to my grandfather, so I am not afraid of further setbacks along the way.
but.
When he learned that Miss Zhu also knew about this, his eyes suddenly became dangerous and he planned to silence her.
Myolie Wu was frightened by his fierce look and immediately spoke kindly to Miss Zhu.
"Yu'er should have known about us for a long time, but she never exposed it.
If he really wanted to harm me, he wouldn't wait until today. "
After hearing this, Chen Jing'an's murderous intention faded slightly.
What Myolie said is true.
But the problem is——
It was okay for her to scold herself, because Chen Jingan would not argue with a woman on such an issue.
But Miss Zhu actually wanted to encourage Myolie Wu to abort his child and then marry someone else.
This is no longer treating yourself as a human being.
There was a dangerous aura in his eyes, but he didn't want to affect Myolie Wu's mood, so he sat on the bed with his arms around her.
With the fragrance and body temperature of Myolie Wu, I gradually calmed down my mood.
Probably because the old man and his second uncle focused on training him these days.
In some matters, Chen Jingan has already made similar decisions to the old man.
But there is still a little gap between him and the old man.
At least, I just thought about killing people and silencing them.
But if it were the old man.
He will always remember Miss Zhu's identity as the county magistrate's daughter, and at least he will not embarrass her in Qinghe County.
After they get out, they will look for opportunities to strike.
But then I thought about it.
From Myolie Wu's perspective, Ms. Zhu's words can be said to be sincere.
But Myolie Wu finally chose him.
This also satisfied Chen Jingan's body and mind at the same time.
He stayed until Myolie Wu fell asleep, and then left quietly.
…
Early the next morning.
After Chen Jingan saw the child, he immediately approached his father to discuss getting married.
Chen's father said that everything was taken care of by him, and urged Chen Jing'an to practice quickly and not to let the old man down.
